scene: Turning the wheel chimes hidden bells, opening three departing transport gates.
picture: Side-view pixel art of three transport stations along the pond edge. On the left, a brass sleigh tram idles on rails. In the centre-left stands the boy in his orange puffer vest and kite. In the centre, a glass-bottomed boat rests at a dock. On the right, a colourful hot-air balloon floats, tied down.
